question:
Select the reagents needed for this SN1 reaction to form tert-butyl ethyl ether under acidic conditions:
Target: tert-Butyl Ethyl Ether (C6H14O)
Available reagents: Ethanol (C2H5OH); tert-Butyl Chloride (C4H9Cl); Sodium Ethoxide (C2H5ONa); Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4); Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH); tert-Butanol (C4H10O)
